title: Silent Night Christmas Door Hanger SVG
author: taramija
description:
📝 Description
Celebrate the true meaning of Christmas with this beautiful Silent Night Nativity Door Hanger SVG. Featuring Mary, Joseph, baby Jesus in the manger, and a gentle sheep surrounded by stars, this layered design creates a warm and peaceful Christmas decoration.
The elegant “Silent Night” lettering and detailed nativity scene make this design perfect for a front door, church décor, Christmas display, or meaningful holiday gift.
✨ Design Features
Beautiful nativity scene
Mary, Joseph & baby Jesus
Adorable sheep detail
“Silent Night” Christmas lettering
Star and Bethlehem-inspired accents
Round layered door hanger design
Rustic wooden aesthetic
Religious Christmas theme
Suitable for laser cutting and engraving
Easy to customize and resize
🎁 Perfect For
Christmas door decor
Nativity Christmas signs
Religious Christmas decorations
Front door hangers
Church Christmas decor
Christian Christmas gifts
Christmas wall decor
Farmhouse holiday decor
